tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// na ma shri ka la tsakra ye// bcom ldan bsgom par 'dod pa yis// sngar bshad sngags kyis kha lag sbyang*// snying khar pad ma zla ba'i dkyil// hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa// 'od 'phros rgyal ba spyan drangs la// phyag rgya sngags kyi mchod pa spro// oṃ ts+tshubadz+ra ghan dhe ghan dha ar tsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swa hā/ oṃ ts+tshubadz+ra ma le ma la ar/ oṃ dhūbadz+ra dhupe dhupa/ oṃ dhūbadz+ra ḍi pe ḍi pa/ oṃ su badz+ra a mri ta ne pe te pu/ oṃ su badz+ra ag k+ṣa te a k+ṣa ta pha la/ oṃ tu badz+ra la s+yai sta a bha ra na/ oṃ tu badz+ra ha s+yai ghan dha badz+ra a dar+sha/ oṃ ku badz+ra bhad t+yai bād tru pu tsa/ oṃ ku badz+ra rni te nre d+ya pu tsa/ oṃ p+pu badz+ra ghi te gha te/ oṃ s+sa badz+ra ka me sarba bhud dha bho dhe sa ta naṃ badz+ra pu ra ta su dze ku ru ku ru swā hā// mchod cing sdig pa gshags sogs bya// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// slan chad nam yang mi bgyid do// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// sna tshogs dge ba gang mdzad pa// rnyog bral byang chub rjes mthun la// kun la dga' bas yid rang ngo*// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs nas kyang// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bsam pa yongs su dag pa yis// byang chub sems ni rab bskyed de// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dor// pha rol phyin pa bcu spyad cing*// tshad med bzhi la gnas pa dang*// bsdu ba rnam bzhis yongs su bsdu// nyon mongs sgrib pa bcu spangs nas// lta sogs zag pa bzhi dor ste// stong nyid mtshan med smon pa bral// mngon par 'du mi byed bsgoms pas// 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir// bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces brjod de hūm̐ las bsdus nas// dngos po med pa bsgom pa min// dngos po'ang bsgom par bya ba min// de bzhin dngos po dngos med min// bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra/ oṃ a ni mi tā dz+nya na badz+ra/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta dz+nya na badz+ra// oṃ a na bhi sang ska ra dz+nya na badz+ra/ swa bha wā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ de nas sngon gyi smon lam las// yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag /ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar// bam̐ las chu ni dkar po zlum// lam̐ las sa ni gru bzhi ser/ mam̐ las ri rab pad ma dang*/ zla nyi sgra gcan dkyil 'khor ldan// de dbus rdo rje'i gur gyi nang*// bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo ni bzhi bzhi ste// rta babs rgyan rnams kyis mdzes pa// re ga gsum dang lnga pa ste// lha snam pha gu dra phyed ni// dkar dmar nag po go rims bzhin// rnga yab rin chen la sogs rgyan// dbus ni sngo dang ljang ba la// phyogs mtshams zhal gyi kha dog mtshungs// sa chu me rlung rdo rje 'od// dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// zla ba nyi ma rtag tu 'char// de dbus k+ṣa las pad ma ljang*// zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan te// g.yas su 'dod lha dmar po ni// mda' lnga zhags pa gzhu lcags kyu// 'dzin pa dga' mo dang bcas pa'o// g.yon na dbang phyug dkar po ni// rtse gsum cang te'u thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wām̐ 'dzin pa dbu mar bcas// a li zla ba me long lha// ka li nyi ma mnyam pa nyid// hūm̐ yig so sor rtog pa sde// srog rlung hi yig bya ba grub// 'phro 'dus rdo rje haṃ gis mtshan// sku rdzogs chos dbyings ye shes te// dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog mthing*// zhal bzhi mgrin pa gsum pa la// rtsa zhal sngon po khro 'dzum pa// g.yas zhal dmar po sgeg cing chags// g.yon zhal dkar po zhi ba'o// rgyab zhal ser po bsam gtan tshul// spyan gsum cod pan rdo rjes mtshan// sngon dmar dkar ba'i dpung pa gsum// gru mo bcu gnyis phyag mgo ni// sngon dmar dkar ba bzhi bzhi'o// phyag 'dzub sa chu me rlung dang*// ye shes mdog can tshigs rnams ni// sngo dmar dkar ba rim bzhin no// rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum dang*// gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu dang*// rngel chung tho ba 'khor lo mdung*// dbyug pa dgra sta g.yas na bsnams// g.yon na dril bu phub kha ṭ+wām̐// thod khrag gzhu zhags rin po che// pad dkar dung dang me long dang*// lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams// zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang pas bdud// g.yon bskum dmar po drag po mnan// dbu yi nor bu rna cha dang*/

mgul rgyan phyag gdub ske rags dang*/ zhabs gdub dar dpyang phreng bas brgyan// stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang*// thal ba mgo 'phreng brgyan pa'o// de yi pang du sna tshogs yum// zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gser gyi mdog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab zhal nag /spyan gsum phyag g.yas gri gug dang*// lcags kyu kha ṭ+wām̐ ka phreng ba// g.yon gyi nya phyis zhags pa dang*// pad ma dkar po rin chen no// phyag rgya lngas brgyan snyoms par 'jug /cod pan rdo rje sems dpas brgyan// 'dab brgyad a ha'i sa bon las// shar dang me ru nag mo 'bar// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar rgyab ser ba// phyag g.yas spos dang tsan dan dang*/ gur gum gla rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa// g.yon na dril bu pad ma dang*// me tog dmar po me tog phreng*// lho dang bden bral dmar mo 'bar// g.yas ser g.yon nag rgyab zhal dkar// phyag g.yas mar me do shal dang*// dbu rgyan gdu gu 'dzin pa'o// g.yon na gos dang ske rags dang*// rna cha rkang brgyan 'dzin par mdzad// nub dang rlung du ser mo 'bar// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab zhal nag /phyag g.yas dung dang gling bu dang*/ nor bu dha ru bsnams pa'o// g.yon pas pi wang rnga zlum dang*/ mkhar khol zangs dung 'dzin pa'o// byang dang dbang ldan dkar mo 'bar/ g.yas nag g.yon ser rgyab zhal dmar// phyag g.yas 'og ma chu bo dang*// lha yi sman dang chang snod 'dzin// g.yon na bdud rtsi dngul chu dang*// bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bral phrol 'dzin// mtshams bzhi rnga yab brgyad 'dzin te// kun kyang zla bar mnyam par gnas// phyag rgya lnga dang ldan par bsgom// nor bu ghan dhe shing dang dung*// rdo rje bzhi yi rang bzhin no// rgyu'i he ru ka'o// de nas gtsug gtor ham̐ yig dang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho sa gnas lngar// hūm̐ las rdo rje phaṭa kyis mtshan// chos 'byung pad ma a lis mtshan// byin brlabs gnyis med snyoms zhugs pas// gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras mchod cing bsdus// yab yum mkhar phab lha rnams bskyed// rim pa dang po'i re mig la// phyogs bcu nyi ma 'tshams zla bar// i ri u ri ring thung las// shar du don grub spyan mas 'khyud/

me ru sgrol ma rnam snang 'khyud/ lho ru rin 'byung ma ma kis// lho nub gos dkar 'od dpag med// byang du dpag med gos dkar 'khyud/ byang shar ma ma ki la ni// rin chen 'byung bas 'khyud pa'o// nub tu snang mdzad sgrol mas mkhyud// rlung du spyan ma don grub can// re mig 'tshams su bum pa ste// ham̐ las dbyangs kyis bsgyur las byung*// rim pa gnyis par sems dpa' rnams// e ar e dang al las byung*// shar sgo'i g.yas su mkha' snying dang*// me ru reg bya rdo rje ma// lho sgo'i g.yas su sa yi snying*// bden bral ro yi rdo rje ma// byang sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang*// dbang ldan gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// nub g.yas sgrib pa rnam sel te// rlung du dri yi rdo rje ma// shar nub lho byang ro mnyam 'khyud// sgo bzhir ya ra wa la las// shar sgor bgegs sgra rengs byed ma// lho ru rmongs byed nga rgyal ma// byang du pad mtha' rmongs byed ma// nub tu gshin rje mthar byed la// shin du stobs mas 'khyud pa'o// mi bskyod rdo rje sems dpa' ni// steng 'og sna tshogs mkha' dbyings ldan// phyag rdor rje rje sgra ma ljang*// chos dbyings rdo rje bzang pos 'khyud// lho dang nub sgo'i g.yon du'o// kun bzang sngon po chos dbyings mas// rdo rje sgra ma phyag rdor bcas// shar dang byang sgo'i g.yon du dgod// thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa// rlung khams 'du byed rigs byung rnams// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus zhal nag /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum g.yas// phub dang thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ g.yon// sgrol ma'i tha ma ud dpal lo// tshor ba'i phung po ma rig kun// g.yas dkar g.yon nag dbus dmar zhal// mda' dang lcags kyu cang tel g.yas// gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu g.yon// 'du shes chu khams las byung rnams// g.yas nag g.yon dmar dbus zhal dkar// tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum g.yas// pad dkar me long phreng ba g.yon// gzugs phung sa khams rin 'byung kun// g.yas dkar g.yon nag dbus ser zhal// 'khor lo dbyug pa rdo rje g.yas// dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu g.yon// nam mkha' ye shes rigs byung rnams// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus ljang sngo// rdo rje gri gug dgra sta g.yas// dril bu thod pa tshangs 'og g.yon// kun bzang tha ma ud pa la'o// kun kyang rdo rje'i rgyan ldan bsgom// phyi rol mchod pa'i snam bu la// shar du dri dang phreng pa tsa// lho ru spos dang mar me ḍa// nub tu sgeg dang bzhad ma ta// byang du bdud rtsi zad med pa// gar dang sil snyan ka las byung*// glu dang 'dod ma pa sde las// shar nub lho byang rta babs te// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi dkyil 'khor snam bu la// phyogs dmar mtshams dkar 'dab brgyad steng*// shar dbus yi dwags dmar ba'i steng*// ha las tsar tsi ka nag mo// phyag g.yas gri gug rtse gsum du// g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ can// dbang po ser po'i thabs dang bcas// 'dab mar hi hī ya las byung*// 'jigs ma la sogs brgyad kyis bskor// me ru mkha' lding steng du ྐྷ// khyab 'jug ma ni g.yas 'khor lo// dbyug tho g.yon na pad ma dung*// tshangs 'khyud 'dab mar k+ṣi ya bsgyur// dpal la sogs pa brgyad kyis bskor// lho ru ma he'i gdan la ha// phag mo dbyug pa ral gri g.yas// g.yon na lu gu rgyud dang phub// drag po dkar pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab brgyad hri dang ra bsgyur las// keng rus ma sogs brgyad kyis bskor// lho nub rma bya'i steng du k+ṣa// gdong drug ma ni g.yas na dung*// lcags kyu g.yon na rin chen zhags// tshogs bdag dkar po'i thabs dang rol// 'dab brgyad k+ṣi ra bsgyur las byung*// pad ma can sogs rnam pa brgyad/

nub tu glang po'i steng du ha// dbang mo g.yas na rdo rje mda'// g.yon na dril bu gzhu 'dzin ma// srin po nag pos 'khyud pa'o// 'dab brgyad h+la la bsgyur las byung*// rdo rje 'od sogs brgyad kyis bskor// rlung mtshams ngang pa'i steng du k+ṣa/ tshangs ma phyag g.yas pad ma dang*// dbyug gu spyi blugs par bu g.yon// khyab 'jug nag po'i thabs dang bcas// 'dab brgyad k+ṣ+li dang la bsgyur las// mchod sbyin 'dod ma la sogs brgyad// byang du khyu mchog steng du haṃ// drag mo rtse gsum cang te'u g.yas// g.yon na kha ṭ+wam̐ kha dang sbrul// gshin rje dmar pos yang dag 'khyud// 'dab brgyad hu hū ba sgyur la// dkar mo la sogs brgyad kyis bskor// dbang ldan seng ge steng du k+ṣaṃ// dpal mo pad ma phreng ba g.yas// g.yon na pad ma rin chen 'dzin// gdong drug dmar po'i thabs kyis 'khyud// 'dab brgyad k+ṣu da ba bsgyur las// dpal dkar la sogs rnam pa brgyad// thams cad phyogs kyi kha dog ste// tshangs ma zhal bzhi gdong drug drug /gzhan rnams zhal cig phyag bzhi ma// gtso mo sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs// 'khor rnams rol pa'i rnams par mtshungs// lte ba'i rtsa dang rlung dag pa'o// phyi rol mchod pa'i rnam bu la// 'dod ma sum cu so drug ste// gsung gi dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa sku yi dkyil 'khor ni// bcu gnyis khyim ste pad ma'i gdan// bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu drug rims// shar sgo'i g.yon du bya khyung steng*// khyab 'jug dpal mos 'khyud pa ste// g.yas na 'khor lo dbyug pa dang*// g.yon pa pad ma dung 'dzin pa// kaṃ ste phrag g.yas chu srin khyim// lho sgo'i g.yon du ma he'i steng*// gshin rje yab yum ngam las byung*// phyag g.yas dbyug pa ral gri dang*// lu gu rgyud dang zhags pa g.yon// bum pa'i khyim dang phrag pa g.yon// shar g.yas yi dwags dmar mo'i steng*// tsa las bden bral srin mos 'khyud// phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug dang*// g.yon na phub dang thod pa can// gru mo g.yas dang nya yi khyim// me 'tshams sha ba'i steng du ni// nyam̐ las rlung lha rab gtum 'khyud// phyag g.yas pad ma lha shing dang*// in tra ni la ud dpal g.yon// gru mo g.yon dang lug gi khyim// lho sgo'i g.yas su ra yi steng*// ṭ+wām̐ las me lha chu mos 'khyud// g.yas na shag ti dang ni mdung*// g.yon pas pad ma spyi blugs 'dzin// glang gi khyim dang khrig ma g.yas// bden bral rma bya'i steng du ni// ṇam̐ las gdong drug dpal mos 'khyud// phyag g.yas shag ti mdung thung dang*// g.yon pa rin chen me long 'dzin/

khrig ma'i khyim dang khrig ma g.yon// byang sgo'i g.yas su chu srin steng*// sam̐ byung chu lha phag mos 'khyud// g.yas na zhags pa rin po che// g.yon na sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin// dpyi g.yas kar ka ta yi khyim// dbang ldan byi ba'i steng du ni// mam̐ byung tshogs bdag gzhon nu ma// phyag g.yas dgra sta rdo rje ste// g.yon na zhags pa rin chen 'dzin// dpyi g.yon seng ge'i khyim rang bzhin// nub sgo'i g.yas su glang chen steng*// tam̐ las brgya byin rlung mos mkhyud// g.yas na rdo rje me yi mda'// g.yon na dril bu gzhu 'dzin ma// bu mo'i khyim dang pus mo g.yas// rlung mtshams ngang pa'i gdan stengs su// nam̐ las tshangs pa glog mas 'khyud// g.yas pas khab dang bgrang phreng ste// g.yon na pad ma spyi blugs 'dzin// pus mo g.yon dang srang gi khyim// byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog steng*// p+pam̐ las dbang phyug dkar mos 'khyud// g.yas su tri shu la dang mda'// g.yon na sbrul dkris kha ṭ+wam̐ gzhu// long bu g.yas dang sdig pa'i khyim// nub sgo'i g.yon du glang gi steng*// k+kam̐ las gnod sbyin nor bzang ma// phyag g.yas rin chen dbyug to can// g.yon pa ne'u le pad ma 'dzin// gzhu yi khyim dang long bu g.yon// thams cad phyogs kyi kha dog can// tshangs pa gdong drug las gzhan kun// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa// dkyil dkrung pad ma'i 'dug stangs dang*// 'khor kun rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs// shar sgor phag bdun shing rta'i steng*// ya las dbyug sngon don grub bzhin// 'od zer can ma g.yas 'khor lo// dbyug pa dung dang rin chen g.yon// lho ru rta bdun shing rta la// ra las 'dod rgyal rin 'byung bzhin// bskul byed g.yas na tho ba mdung*// g.yon pa pad ma me long 'dzin// nub tu glang bdun shing rta'i steng*// la las stobs chen rnam snang 'dra// lcags sgrog ral gri rdo rje g.yas// g.yon pa phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa'o// byang du seng ge bdun shing rta// ba la mi g.yo 'od dpag 'dra/

khro gnyer ma g.yas mda' lcags kyu// g.yon na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin// steng du bya khyung bdun shing rta// haṃ las gtsug gtor phyag rdor 'dra// shin du sngon mo g.yas gri gug /rdo rje g.yon na thod dril 'dzin// sa 'og rkang brgyad shing rta la// ha las gnod mdzes kun bzang bzhin// gtum mo dgra sta rtse gsum g.yas// g.yon na sbrul dang kha ṭ+wām̐ 'dzin// nyi mar g.yas g.yon brkyang pas bzhugs// sku yi rta babs ka ba'i rtsar// ha la ya ra ba las bsgyur// shar du pad ma stobs kyi rgyu// lho ru nor rgyas dung skyong ste// nub tu 'jog po pad ma che// byang du mtha' yas rigs ldan te// steng du rgyal dang rnam par rgyal// zhal cig phyag bzhi rab gtum 'khyud// bdud rtsi'i bum pa rdo rje g.yas// g.yon du pad ma rin chen 'dzin// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs so// phyi rol mchod lha so drug ste// mi 'dod rtog pa rnam dag pa// sku yi dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo// me rlung dbus su dur khrod brgyad/ khyi gdong khwa gdong phag bya rgod// lce spyang khyung dang stag 'ug pa// shar nas g.yas bskor rim pas dgod// shin du sngon mo rdo rje'i mig /steng 'og klu bcu'i thabs dang bcas// gri gug thod pa phyag na 'dzin// rtsegs ma'i sngags dang ham̐ ha byung*// mchod rten me chu shing dang sprin// gza' dang rgyu skar khyim drang srong*// grub pa ro langs nag po che// dga' byed 'phrog ma bum rna can// bye ba phyed bzhi 'byung po rnams/ thar pa'i grong khyer phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs nas// 'od 'phros 'gro kun dkyil 'khor bzhugs// ye shes dkyil 'khor lus la dgod// rang rang zhing du lhar spros nas// ye shes chags pa'i mes bzhu nas// thig le ham̐ bcas mkha' 'drar blta// lha mos tshad med glu yis bskul// spyan ma dag ni 'gro ba'i ma// rgyu mthun rnal 'byor mar gnas so// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bdag la 'dod pa spyod// stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// 'khor ba rtogs pa'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i mgon po rang gis spros// ma ma kri ni sring mo bdag

/rnam smin rnal 'byor mar gnas pa// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor man 'dra'o// gos dkar bu mo ru ni bdag /skyes bu'i rnal 'byor mar gnas pa// dkyil 'khor lnga yi rang bzhin te// dus 'khor= sgrol ma tsha mo yi ni bdag /dri med rnal 'byor ma ru gnas// bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin te// dus 'khor bzhengs= glu yi rdo rje spyan sad nas// srid gsum sgyu ma lta bur gzigs// sa bon phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs bsgom// thugs khar rdo rje haṃ hūṃ ho// oṃ ā swa hā dang bcas pas// 'od 'phros khro bo rdo rje shugs// gnyis lhag phyag can spros nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas rnams bkug ste// dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho hi zhes pas// dgug gzhug bcing dgyes ro mnyam bya// slar yang gnas gsum yi ge las// 'od 'phros rdo rje gsum bkug ste// sku ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas nag g.yon dmar dbus dkar mo// 'khor lo rdo rje pad ma g.yas// gsung ni g.yas dkar g.yon zhal nag /pad ma rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas// thugs ni g.yas dmar g.yon zhal dkar// rdo rje 'khor lo pad ma g.yas// g.yon kun dril bu rin chen dang*// ral gri 'dzin pa yum dang bcas// gnas gsum byin brlabs dbang bskur bsam// dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni// rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol// aḥdapal ldan rdo rje gsung*// hūm̐ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ka ya wāka tsi t+ta badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3 haṃ// de ltar dbang bskur byin brlabs nas/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan la// gtso bo bde stong rang bzhin te// sku la thugs te gsung la sku// me la chu ste rlung la me// phyogs rnams rang rang bdag po yin// dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo// ngag gi bzlas pa byed pa na// kha dog lnga ldan spro bsdu dang*// 'gog pa rdo rje bzlas pa ni// oṃ aḥhūm̐ ho haṃḥk+ṣa ma la wa la ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā// oṃ hram̐ hring hram̐ hrum̐ h+lam̐ hraḥzhes 'don pa'i rim pas bzlas so// thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/

mkha' gsang ho ham̐ bde chen la// mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba bsgom// de nas phyi nang gsang ba yis// mchod de bstod la mnyam par bzhag /las kyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas// rnam dag dran byas bsdu ba'i tshe// 'khor lo bzhi dang lte ba dang*// tshigs la dkyil 'khor gsum po bsdu// rgyun du bsgom pa'i phyir rang byung rol ba'i rdo rjes bsdus pa'o/// // /
